Mental states to track: for RECOMMENDER, track knowledge of already discussed/recommended movies, beliefs about SEEKER’s genre likes/dislikes, desire/goal to recommend, conversational intention, expectation of SEEKER’s reactions, and likely next strategy. Optionally track SEEKER’s preferences/emotion to ground the latest exchange.
